question: What decisive bodily event marks the moment of final release at death?
premises: The skull is pierced at that time
This moment is addressed to the goddess
inference: Final release is marked when the skull is pierced at the fall of the body.
uncertainties: The exact yogic mechanism of kapāla-bheda is not fully specified.
